fho.review:
Faculty Review - Fho Ma'am
Course: MIC315
Last semester a unar section neyar age almost shobai bolechilo uni naki oneekk baje grade den, class a shudhu reading poran and quiz, mid onkkk hard koren...tao amar ekta frnd er kothay shahosh kore niyechilam...honestly, she is  good and kindhearted as a faculty... Unar first semester a student der shathe unar valo interaction na howay almost maximum student ee kharap korechilo... But unar 2nd semester a uni shob valovabe recover korechen....mane ja review peyechilam uni thik tar ulto...ami shobaike bolbo jodi unar course pan tahole drop diben naa just ektu effort dile valo grade ashb in sha Allah ...
Exam system :
★ Quiz (3 out of 4) - MCQ/TF
★ MID & FINAL- Sample question diye den and oi jayga thekei ashe....main point gula likhe dile uni almost full marks diye den.
★ Viva- ektu beshi question dhoren but onkkk easy thake
Lastly, ma'am er kache always grateful thakbo cz uni amr onkk boro ekta upokar korechen jeta onno kono faculty hoyto konodino korten na...May Allah bless her
mcq 8ta r 2 ta t/f...2 tar majhe ekta true hole porer ta must false hobe

I’ve done Bio202 and Mic201 under her. And ended up with best grades.She’s a gem. Onar behaviour o onek sweet. Khub kom requirement e onar kache valo mark paoa jay. Pleople talk negative about her cause she was new here and wasn’t familiar with the environment. But she became more friendly after those things.
Mam considers a lot. Helps at personal problems if you share those to her.
NSU is blessed for these type of faculties. May Allah bless her and grant her wellness.

Maam best

1st semester er kotha to bollam ee...but 2nd semester a amader section a onekei A peyeche....shobai deserving grade peyeche

amra jokhon Ma'am er under e class korsilam Ma'am amader marks den naai. amra point out kore likheo mark paini and when we asked Ma'am mark den ni keno she said shudhu shudhu etuku likhlei ki cholbe? amader time e Ma'am 20 ta question diten quiz e jekhane 5 ta fill in the gap thakto almost puro semester jure amra Ma'am ke bolsi quiz er pattern change korte then she settled for 2-3 fill in the gaps.
